extracted.intended_audience: university researchers, principal investigators, and research administrators at U.S. institutions preparing MURI proposals to ONR/DoD
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for submitting White Papers and Full Proposals to the Department of Defense Multidisciplinary Research Program of the University Research Initiative (MURI) for Fiscal Year 2025, including scope, eligibility, deadlines, required templates, and COI policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program scope and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The MURI program supports basic research in science and engineering at U.S. institutions of higher education (hereafter referred to as "universities") that is of potential interest to DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This BAA targets basic (fundamental) research in science and engineering; proposals should align with DoD interest areas described in the full announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multidisciplinary research focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The program is focused on multidisciplinary research efforts where more than one traditional discipline interacts to provide rapid advances in scientific areas of interest to the DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate genuine interdisciplinary interaction (more than one traditional discipline) aimed at producing rapid advances; single-discipline projects or loosely coupled collaborations may not meet this requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Research must be conducted at U.S. institutions of higher education (hereafter referred to as "universities").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be affiliated with eligible U.S. universities; see the full announcement for any additional eligibility nuances or exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to DoD
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects must be of potential interest to DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly articulate how the proposed basic research is relevant to DoD interests and priorities described in the full announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: White Papers due no later than: May 17, 2024 5:00 PM EST. Full Proposals will be accepted until: September 06, 2024 5:00 PM EST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet these submission windows and times (EST); check the full announcement for any additional timeline milestones, pre-registration, or amendment-related date changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required standardized submission templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Required: All BAAs incorporate a standardized template for the submission of technical and cost proposals for all contract awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must use the provided template(s) (downloadable forms such as N0001424SF002.pdf and amendments). Guidance and assistance in completing the form and spreadsheet can be obtained from points of contact provided in the BAA; failure to use required templates may render a submission noncompliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of Interest policy
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure fairness in the consideration of proposals, ONR has implemented policies to protect against organizational conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should review and comply with ONR's organizational conflicts of interest policies (linked from the announcement) and follow any disclosure or mitigation requirements specified in the full BAA.
